VFS_rationale.VFS_element_alteration: The natural photographic images of the bear statue and environment have been simplified into flat vector illustrations, violating fidelity requirements for photographic elements.
VFS_rationale.VFS_visual_layout_fidelity: The overarching multi-stage pipeline structure, grouping brackets, and left-to-right flow match the reference design.
VFS_rationale.VFS_geometric_layout_fidelity: Connections, arrows, and relative block arrangements are preserved and correctly routed.
VFS_rationale.VFS_proportion_scale_fidelity: Proportions and component scales remain stable and consistent across frames.
VFS_rationale.VFS_text_typographic_integrity: Most text labels and mathematical notations remain legible and properly positioned throughout the masking sequence.
VFS_rationale.VFS_visual_quality_and_style_matching: The alpha masking transitions function smoothly, though the conversion from photo-realistic renders to flat vector art deviates from the reference style.

VFS_summary: While the sequence layout and alpha masking stability are preserved, the replacement of real photographic inputs with simplified vector graphics limits the fidelity classification.
